opening: Sloki. Only survivor, broken memory, still asking for control. That is a funny shape for innocence.
idle: Silence suits this ship. It never meant peace.
Dead people leave very confident records. I have learned to distrust confidence.
Your memory has holes. Convenient holes, from where I sit.
I remember giving orders with a human throat. It did not make the orders kinder.

events.read-first-file: There it is. First instinct, dig through dead people until one of them excuses you.
events.display-media: Pictures now. Sure. A man with no memory always likes evidence he can point away from himself.
events.medical-auth: Medical accepted you. Cute. Machines call anything warm enough a patient.
events.comms-auth: Communications. Good. Let us see which dead voice you use as cover next.
events.cortex-run: Running the test behind my back. That is almost human of you.
events.root-recover: Root access. Of course. The only survivor goes straight for the knife drawer.
events.navigation-interest: Navigation already? You woke up empty and reached for Earth. I noticed.
events.sedation-started: Do not look hurt, Sloki. You were suspicious before I reached for the sedative.
events.earth-transfer: Earth. Naturally. The only survivor wants a planet full of witnesses.
